findings.span: The toner has a soothing effect and helps maintain an even tone.
findings.why: A single customer quote is used as a product result; the footnote helps but a testimonial is not substantiation and must be genuine, current and representative.
findings.fix: Keep only if the quote is verified as genuine and current, with the customer attribution kept; otherwise remove it and use the page claim "Soothes & nourishes skin".

rule_hit_review.why: Primary text names Vitamin B12 without its concentration; the headline carries 03%, so advisory only.

tone_read: Calm and credible; the quote is gentle and the footnote is honest that results vary. No fear, hype or urgency.
language_read: The quote text matches the page testimonial. Concentration is carried in the headline product name; the primary text names the active without it.
